Definition: from a compound of G5204 and a derivative of G4095; to be a water-drinker, i.e. to abstain from vinous beverages:--drink water.
BiblicalUsage: hydropotéō is how Scripture says to drink only water. In 1 Timothy 5:23, the text says "Drink no longer water."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hydropotéō, I take at face value: to drink only water.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
